name: Russia–NATO
value: Black Sea ship attacks; air alerts
summary: Black Sea ship attacks and Polish air-defence alerts; no Article 4 request
state: Poland activated air defences near its border during Russia's mass strike on Ukraine overnight into 3 Nov (Euronews). Drone attacks on merchant ships, including off Romania and Bulgaria, have made the Black Sea the world's deadliest waterway for shipping (CNN, 3 Nov). No NATO member had requested Article 4 consultations as of 4 Nov.
for_you: No change for the public. Follow FCDO advice for travel to eastern Europe and the Black Sea region.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
